name: Kamalgad Fort
description: Kamalgad Fort is a lesser-known hill fort located near Wai in Satara district. Known for its unique geological feature called the 'Geru well', a deep vertical pit carved into the rock, the fort offers a short yet adventurous trek with scenic views of the Dhom Dam and surrounding Sahyadri ranges.

routes.name: Tupewadi Route (Main)
routes.description: Forest trail followed by steep climb and short rock patch near the top.

landmarks.name: Geru Well
landmarks.description: A deep cylindrical pit carved into the rock, accessed via steps inside.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Unique feature possibly used as prison or storage.

landmarks.name: Fort Plateau
landmarks.description: Flat top area with great views.

landmarks.name: Dhom Dam View
landmarks.description: Panoramic view of Dhom Dam and valley.

alerts.message: Final rock patch requires careful climbing
Geru well is deep — avoid careless entry

history.brief: Kamalgad Fort served as a strategic lookout connected to nearby forts through signaling systems.
history.significance: Important for surveillance and communication in the Maratha network.
